metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Back Pain in 30 Seconds
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy back exercises that can give instant pain relief within 30 seconds! 

We're going to break this video into three separate parts that each focus on a different main cause of back pain. This includes: 

Muscle tightness, spasms, knots and trigger points
Joint stiffness (and arthritis)
Muscle weakness

To get the best results, go through all three parts and use what works best for you. As a bonus, all of these exercises can be done at home and require no special equipment.

Watch now and quickly fix your back pain at home! 

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:00 Muscle Tightness Quick Fix
4:31 Lower Back Stiffness Release
9:04 Upper Back Stiffness Release
10:56 Lower Back Strengthening 
13:27 Upper Back Strengthening
